caption: The drawing depicts a lantern with a hexagonal prism-shaped body constructed from brown metallic material and transparent panels, likely glass, held in place by vertical and horizontal metal rods that form a cage around the glass. The top of the lantern is a tapered, triangular structure with a circular decorative element featuring a star and radiating lines. A large, circular metal ring is attached to the apex of the lantern for carrying or hanging. Inside the lantern, there is a cylindrical candle or light source with visible wax drips, colored in shades of grey and brown. The overall palette of the image is muted and earthy, with the brown tones of the metal, the translucent light blue-grey of the glass, and the off-white or beige background. The background is plain and untextured, ensuring the lantern is the sole focus of the composition.
title: Lantern
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
